This report summarizes the epidemiologic investigation and the ensuing public health response.
Of 29 possible contacts identified, 20 were deemed to be potentially exposed and received PEP.
Sixteen of those 20 were household members.
Four persons who received PEP were health-care providers.
To date, all known contacts of the patient in the United States have no evidence of rabies.
A total of 20 persons, mostly household contacts, received postexposure prophylaxis (PEP)

methods_quotes.q: Assessments of potential exposure were made in accordance with Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices recommendations
